verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. The CTA sits at the very top, above the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The large image slot shows only blurred brown background, and the Quillbrook bag (the key product) shrinks to an illegible thumbnail at the bottom next to a tiny logo. The SAVE 15% badge is oversized and competes with the headline. A is marginally better because it leaves a gap between the body copy and the image; in B the image butts straight against 'you like.' and runs almost edge to edge.
